reviews.title: Amazing Game
reviews.text: I grew up playing turn based games on my parents computer and haven’t found any that I liked until I downloaded this one either last year or two years ago before a flight. I loved the game so much I bought it and it was one of the first apps I downloaded when I got a new phone. I love everything about it and I would’ve put 5 stars, but the change to collecting the after quest gold being from a tap off a button to having to watch an ad is a buzzkill. I know the developer needs to make money and it’s honestly not that big of a deal, I’m just not a fan of ads and before the game had none. Besides that the game is amazing. I’ve created a total of four characters and have put in way too many hours I’d like to admit.
